name: A Werewolf Opportunity, Obviously
source:
On the heels of his best friend getting married and tired of letting all his relationships fizzle out before they even get started, 20-something Eddie decides he's going to find a boyfriend and give it his all in a serious relationship! But in a town where magic is lurking just below the surface, can Eddie make it work — or will the more human side of life hold him back again?

[From [url=https://arcadeparty.itch.io/awoo]itch.io[/url]]
